visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a light green t-shirt is crouched in a hallway next to a wall with a 'BONBOX' sign; he suddenly pops up into a medium close-up, pointing at a lunch box he is holding while smiling excitedly at the camera. Behind him is a glass door reflecting an outdoor street with a pink scooter. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the white rectangular lunch box filled with purple rice, a whole orange sweet potato/pumpkin piece, green leafy vegetables, a sliced boiled egg, and several thick slices of white chicken breast. A silver spoon enters the frame from the top, drizzling chunky red chili sauce over the chicken slices. (3) The camera returns to the man holding the box in a medium shot; he talks with high facial animation and gestures toward the food. He then uses wooden chopsticks to lift a piece of chicken to his mouth and eats it with an exaggerated expression of satisfaction and wide eyes. (4) The final scene shows a static promotional setup on a counter. A poster on the right features the man holding a bowl, alongside text and a date range. To the left sits a jar of the red chili sauce with a logo, and the prepared lunch box is displayed in the center on a wooden tray.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, synthesized 'whoosh' transition effect that pans quickly across the stereo field. Immediately, a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming pattern enters at approximately 105 BPM, accompanied by a clean, consistent kick and snare drum beat. A male narrator begins speaking in Mandarin with exceptionally high arousal and a cheerful, fast-paced delivery style. (2) The narration remains the primary acoustic signal, exhibiting significant pitch variability as the speaker emphasizes specific ingredients like 'chicken breast' and 'chili sauce.' The background music maintains a stable, uplifting major-key tonality. No significant ambient noise is present, suggesting a highly controlled recording environment. (3) The vocal intensity increases slightly as the speaker delivers a call to action regarding the April 30th deadline. The music reaches a melodic peak before ending on a final, resolved guitar chord that coincides with the end of the vocal track. A soft percussive hit marks the final frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a limited-time collaboration lunch box between the brand 'BONBOX' and the influencer/brand 'Charlie Eat Finish' (吃完啦), specifically highlighting the addition of a special chili sauce to a healthy meal option.
